services.name: Park Admission & Mini Golf
services.desc: Encompassing 500 acres in the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains, Noccalula Falls Park and Campground is a landmark destination in Northeast Alabama. Created by the City of Gadsden and managed by Noccalula Falls Park staff, the park originally opened in 1953 and welcomes hikers, campers, and families from around the world. February 16th - October 24th Daily hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Extended summer hours on Saturday & Sunday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM (June and July) Park Hours could be affected by Special Events. services.name: Rock Climbing At Noccalula Falls
services.desc: Native Land: S’atsoyaha (Yuchi) , Shawandasse Tula (Shawanwaki/Shawnee) (from Native-land.ca) Noccalula Falls was established as a public park in the early 1950s. Reports of climbers exploring, scaling the cliffline and scrambling on boulders date back to as early as the 1970s and 1980s. At that time, Noccalula was like a playground for climbers. Noccalula Falls has a mysterious history of climbing that centered around an ethic of anonymity. No photos, no route names and no grades. This practice was not motivated by exclusivity, but from a desire to simply have a playground for climbers and cavers alike.
